title: bStocks Moves Ahead of Ondo by Tokenized Stock Value on RWA.xyz
description: RWA.xyz ranked bStocks first among tokenized-stock platforms on October 27, with $1.3 billion of value versus $914.1 million for Ondo.
why_it_matters: The ranking marks a measurable competitive shift since bStocks crossed $1 billion, while showing that product count and capital concentration can tell different market-share stories.
keyTakeaways: RWA.xyz ranked bStocks first by distributed tokenized-stock value at $1.3 billion on October 27, ahead of Ondo at $914.1 million.
The data provider counted 99 bStocks products and 408 Ondo products, so the ranking reflects value rather than breadth of listings.
RWA.xyz identifies BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, as the issuer of the certificate-based bStocks products.
body:
Coinfomania reported on October 26 that an ARK Invest repost had highlighted bStocks moving ahead of Ondo. A live RWA.xyz market snapshot reviewed on October 27 independently showed bStocks at the top of its distributed tokenized-stock league table with $1.3 billion of value, compared with $914.1 million for Ondo.

The ranking measures tokenized-stock value, not the number of available products. RWA.xyz counted 99 bStocks entries and 408 Ondo entries in the same table. Its separate bStocks profile reported $1.33 billion of distributed asset value, 1,580,086 holders and $9.37 billion of monthly transfer volume as of October 27.

RWA.xyz describes bStocks as certificates issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, representing interests in underlying securities held by the issuer. The snapshot documents a current ranking change; it does not establish that bStocks will retain the lead or that the products confer direct ownership of underlying company shares.

RWA.xyz ranked Ondo second with $914.1 million of distributed tokenized-stock value.
The league table counted 99 bStocks products and 408 Ondo products.
RWA.xyz reported $1.33 billion of distributed asset value for bStocks on October 27.
RWA.xyz identifies BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, as the bStocks issuer.
